o.text: From yarım (“half”) + ada (“island”). Possibly a calque of Russian полуостров (poluostrov, “peninsula”, literally “half-island”).
from Proto-Turkic *küńe (“moth”), *kuńa (“moth”). Cognate with Chuvash кӗве (kĕve), etc.

From Arabic رُوحِيّ (rūḥiyy). By surface analysis, ruh + -i.
